title: Conditions to check for Free Plan Storage

question.author: member_215
question.body: Could support clarify free plan storage in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: The free plan was raised from 5 GB to 10 GB with CloudBox 2.0 (September 2023). The current limit is 10 GB. The CloudBox free plan includes 10 GB of storage, shared across all files you own. This limit applies to the total size of your synced files plus anything you upload through the web app or mobile clients. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
